description: Control analysis: isolate the Glu-to-Ser side-chain contribution to pocket volume and compare apo CASDC structures
code:
import requests, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
H={"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"}
def g(u,**kw):
    r=requests.get(u,headers=H,timeout=300,**kw); r.raise_for_status(); return r
three={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I','LEU':'L',
 'LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','LLP':'K','MSE':'M'}
def atoms(txt):
    o=[]
    for ln in txt.split("\n"):
        if ln.startswith(("ATOM  ","HETATM")):
            try:o.append(dict(name=ln[12:16].strip(),alt=ln[16],resn=ln[17:20].strip(),ch=ln[21],resi=int(ln[22:26]),
                xyz=np.array([float(ln[30:38]),float(ln[38:46]),float(ln[46:54])]),b=float(ln[60:66] or 0)))
            except ValueError:pass
    return [a for a in o if a["alt"] in (" ","A")]
def cavity(prot_xyz,centre,box=11.0,step=0.5,probe=1.4,vdw=1.7,burial=55):
    rng=np.arange(-box,box+1e-9,step)
    G=np.stack(np.meshgrid(rng,rng,rng,indexing="ij"),-1).reshape(-1,3)+centre
    G=G[np.linalg.norm(G-centre,axis=1)<=box]
    T=cKDTree(prot_xyz); dmin,_=T.query(G)
    nb=np.array([len(x) for x in T.query_ball_point(G,8.0)])
    sel=(dmin>(vdw+probe))&(nb>=burial)
    return sel.sum()*step**3
def fit(ref,tgt,anchors):
    cA={(a["ch"],a["resi"]):a["xyz"] for a in ref if a["name"]=="CA"}
    cB={(a["ch"],a["resi"]):a["xyz"] for a in tgt if a["name"]=="CA"}
    P=[];Q=[]
    for ch,i,j in anchors:
        if (ch,i) in cA and (ch,j) in cB: P.append(cA[(ch,i)]);Q.append(cB[(ch,j)])
    P=np.array(P);Q=np.array(Q);pc=P.mean(0);qc=Q.mean(0)
    V,S,Wt=np.linalg.svd((P-pc).T@(Q-qc));d=np.sign(np.linalg.det(V@Wt));R=V@np.diag([1,1,d])@Wt
    return (lambda X:(X-pc)@R+qc), float(np.sqrt((((P-pc)@R+qc-Q)**2).sum(1).mean())), len(P)

ref=atoms(g("https://files.rcsb.org/download/3N29.pdb").text)
nsd=np.array([a["xyz"] for a in ref if a["resn"]=="NSD"]); cen=nsd.mean(0)
prot3=[a for a in ref if a["resn"] in three]
X3=np.array([a["xyz"] for a in prot3])
v3=cavity(X3,cen)

# CONTROL 1: in-silico Glu236 -> Ser truncation in 3N29 (delete CG, CD, OE1, OE2 of A/236)
mask=[not (a["ch"]=="A" and a["resi"]==236 and a["name"] in ("CG","CD","OE1","OE2")) for a in prot3]
v3_E236S=cavity(X3[np.array(mask)],cen)
print(f"3N29 as deposited (Glu236)                 : {v3:7.0f} A^3")
print(f"3N29 with Glu236 side chain truncated to Ser: {v3_E236S:7.0f} A^3   (delta {v3_E236S-v3:+.0f})")

rows=[("3N29 C. jejuni CANSDC (holo, Glu236)",v3)]
anch=dict(
 _36GY=[("A",41,42),("A",166,171),("A",169,174),("A",201,206),("A",202,207),("A",233,239),("A",236,242),("A",272,279),("A",276,283),("A",342,338),("A",346,342),("B",313,309),("B",314,310),("B",350,346)],
 _9EAF=[("A",41,43),("A",166,170),("A",169,173),("A",201,205),("A",202,206),("A",233,237),("A",236,240),("A",272,276),("A",276,280),("A",342,335),("A",346,339),("B",313,306),("B",314,307),("B",350,343)])
for pid,key,lab in [("36GY","_36GY","36GY B. fragilis CASDC (apo, Ser242)"),("9EAF","_9EAF","9EAF C. leptum CASDC (apo, Glu240)")]:
    t=atoms(g(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{pid}.pdb").text)
    T,rms,n=fit(ref,t,anch[key])
    X=np.array([a["xyz"] for a in t if a["resn"] in three])
    vv=cavity(X,T(cen))
    print(f"{lab:44s}: {vv:7.0f} A^3   (anchor RMSD {rms:.2f} A over {n} CAs)")
    rows.append((lab,vv))
# AlphaFold monomer of BT_0674 cannot be used for the cavity: the pocket is completed by the partner subunit
print("\nNote: the AlphaFold DB entry for Q8A9Z1 is a monomer, and three of the pocket residues")
print("(Cys309, Leu310, Phe346) come from the partner subunit, so no cavity was computed from it.")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8,4.6))
labs=[r[0] for r in rows]+["3N29 with Glu236\ntruncated to Ser (in silico)"]
vals=[r[1] for r in rows]+[v3_E236S]
cols=["#8d6e63","#2e7d32","#8d6e63","#ef6c00"]
ax.barh(range(len(vals)),vals,color=cols)
for i,v_ in enumerate(vals): ax.text(v_+5,i,f"{v_:.0f}",va="center",fontsize=9)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(vals))); ax.set_yticklabels(labs,fontsize=8); ax.invert_yaxis()
ax.set_xlabel("buried cavity volume within 11 $\\AA$ of the product site ($\\AA^3$)")
ax.set_title("Substrate channel volume in CASDC/CANSDC active sites",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
